facts.fact: Media Dynamics estimated the 2026-27 primetime upfront average streaming CPM for adults at $25.90, down 4.9% from the prior season.
facts.quote: estimated the **2026-27 primetime upfront** average streaming CPM for adults at **$25.90**, down **4.9%** from the prior season.

facts.fact: Media Dynamics estimated the 2026-27 primetime upfront broadcast CPM at $41.65 per thousand adults for a 30-second announcement, down 4.2%.
facts.quote: The same release puts broadcast at **$41.65** per thousand adults for a 30-second announcement (down 4.2%)

facts.fact: Media Dynamics estimated the 2026-27 primetime upfront cable CPM at $17.70, down 8.5%.
Media Dynamics estimated 2026-27 primetime upfront ad investment at $33.8 billion, up 9.1%.
facts.quote: estimates primetime upfront ad investment at **$33.8 billion** (up 9.1%)

facts.fact: Media Dynamics reports $17.2 billion of the 2026-27 primetime upfront went to streaming and $16.6 billion to linear.
facts.quote: with **$17.2 billion** in streaming and **$16.6 billion** in linear.

facts.fact: Media Dynamics says streaming accounts for 25% of available primetime ad GRPs in the 2026-27 upfront.
facts.quote: The release also says streaming accounts for 25% of available primetime ad GRPs

facts.fact: Media Dynamics reports that primetime CPMs, counting linear and streaming together, were down 6.2% in the 2026-27 upfront.
facts.quote: Primetime CPMs, counting linear and streaming together, were down 6.2%.

facts.fact: MediaPost reports prior-season upfront CPM levels of $27.75 for streaming, $43.50 for broadcast and $19.35 for cable, a figure that differs from the Media Dynamics press release's stated percent changes.
facts.quote: gives the prior-season levels as $27.75 streaming, $43.50 broadcast, and $19.35 cable

facts.fact: MediaPost gives the 2026-27 upfront ad total as $33.7 billion, while the Media Dynamics press release states $33.8 billion.
facts.quote: MediaPost's dollar total for the upfront ($33.7 billion) also differs from the press release ($33.8 billion).

facts.fact: The ANA Q1 2026 Programmatic Transparency Benchmark recorded an overall programmatic CPM of $4.42, down from $5.55 in Q4 2025; the figure covers web, mobile and CTV combined.
facts.quote: $4.42 CPM (down from $5.55 in Q4 2025) | Overall programmatic CPM | [ANA Q1 2026 Programmatic Transparency Benchmark]

facts.fact: The ANA benchmark's participating marketers rose from 54 to 86 in Q1 2026.
facts.quote: participating marketers rose from 54 to 86 in Q1 2026.

facts.fact: ANA TrueCPM for Q1 2026 was $7.46 per thousand qualified impressions for higher performing advertisers versus $19.04 for lower performing advertisers.
facts.quote: $7.46 vs $19.04 | TrueCPM: cost per thousand _qualified_ impressions, higher vs lower performing advertisers

facts.fact: Battleground-state CTV CPMs during the political season reached about $43, according to The Streaming Wars report dated October 26, 2026.
facts.as_of: Q4 2026; The Streaming Wars report October 26, 2026
facts.quote: About $43 CPM | Battleground-state CTV CPMs during the political season

facts.fact: AdImpact projects $11.6 billion in political advertising for the 2025-2026 cycle, including $2.7 billion on CTV, as reported by The Streaming Wars.
facts.quote: AdImpact projects $11.6 billion in political advertising for the 2025-2026 cycle, including $2.7 billion on CTV

facts.fact: Tatari client data for 2019-2023, as reported by Web Tonic, show an average CPM of about $9.50 for streaming and about $2.50 for linear.
facts.quote: About $9.50 streaming vs about $2.50 linear | Average CPM in client campaigns | Tatari client data 2019-2023

facts.fact: Keynes Digital's undated CTV rate guide lists typical CTV quoted rates of $35-$65, Hulu at $30, and broadcast/cable linear at $10-$15.
facts.quote: $35-$65 CTV; Hulu $30; broadcast/cable linear $10-$15 | Typical quoted rates | [Keynes CTV rate guide]

facts.fact: Keynes says its CTV rates fluctuate with demand and are negotiable.
facts.quote: The Keynes page itself says rates fluctuate with demand and are negotiable

facts.fact: Streaming primetime upfront spending was up nearly 30%, while broadcast dollars were down 5.3% and cable dollars were down 7.7%, per Media Dynamics.
facts.quote: Streaming spending was up nearly 30%. Broadcast dollars were down 5.3%. Cable dollars were down 7.7%.

facts.fact: A sponsored AdExchanger article claims programmatic DSP and SSP fees can take 30% to 50% of spend; this comes from a vendor promoting a direct-integration product, not an audited measurement.
facts.quote: can take 30% to 50% of spend. That figure comes from a vendor promoting a direct-integration product, not an audited measurement.
